userDecision: Current investigation and implementation use8.3.27. 8.3.24 execution is outside this task.
method: Separate COM connection/process per query. Loaded comcntr.dll FileVersionInfo.FileVersion confirmed8.3.27.2170. Native errors repeated through VBScript IDispatch because PowerShell masks native COM descriptions with NullReferenceException. No application query model involved.
findings: Parameters, arithmetic, scalar functions, CASE and nested GROUPEDBY with record-independent operands are accepted both with and without GROUP BY; observed result=false.
SUM(1), COUNT(*) and a subquery inside the operand are rejected both with and without GROUP BY.
Explicit GROUP BY1 and GROUP BY&Parameter do not change the observed false for constant/parameter GROUPEDBY operands.
Combined with14 original cases:32 distinct queries,19 successful and13 rejected.
Exact grouped expression matching remains required for row-dependent operands; absence of GROUP BY cannot silently bypass the check.
